### Countries within South America (per OWID definition) that had a relative change ≥ 100 % in the number of Internet users between 2011 and 2021

For each South‑American country we:

1. Retrieved the **number of people using the Internet** for 2011 and 2021 from the OWID “Number of people using the Internet” dataset (`number‑of‑internet‑users.csv`).
2. Calculated the **percentage change**:
   \[
   \frac{\text{Users 2021} - \text{Users 2011}}{\text{Users 2011}} \times 100\%
   \]
3. Selected countries where this relative change was **≥ 100 %** (i.e., the 2021 figure was at least twice the 2011 figure).
4. For those countries, sorted by the magnitude of the increase from highest to lowest.

| Rank | Country | Users 2011 (thousands) | Users 2021 (thousands) | % Increase |
|------|---------|------------------------|------------------------|------------|
